  "evidence": "# Screen181: QA rounds, signed inspections and follow-up

The Quality Officer/in-charge inspects current practices, signs the permanent record and follows findings with named work. QaRounds.tsx uses the established office-review, guarded-write, named-directory, bilingual help and shared zoom patterns. Three server status cards show actual intervals/active counts/last round and Due in amber/text, including the storage inspection. History filters and real server cursors open exact signed records. No facility-category or local-role branch was added; permissions and server view/noNewWork decide available work.

A new round loads every active question in position order with no default answers. Needs attention requires an observation; recommendations/remarks and hospital time are recorded. Earlier paper dates are allowed, future dates refused. The final dialog states submission IS signing, applies the real in-charge stamp and keeps the record permanently; there is no signed-round edit/delete. Checklist snapshots and a fresh preflight prevent silently replacing the questions a user reviewed. Catalogue managers can add a new code/question, reword/reorder or retire by loaded expected_version; historical wording remains. Finding actions use eligible named people/user references and active departments, never typed ids. Creates/signatures/actions retry only their original frozen body/key; versioned edits reconcile by GET only. A reviewed create hold closes its unsent form without asserting success or submitting a replacement.

## Actual fresh synthetic DEV execution

Initial server status was three never-conducted checklists, active Daily15/Monthly13/Storage12. Stable inputs181-test-inputs.json identify ONLY our new question; no manual seed question was modified. The primary actual Quality UI created ownquestion45 (201lost/original-key replay→oneactivev1), reworded/reordered it v1→2 with one real200lost PATCH and GET-only reconciliation, preserved/cancelled the stale editor. It answered all16current Daily questions deliberately, including one NeedsAttention. Required observation, native future-time refusal, earlier paper time, F1/focus, a genuine lost GET/visible ErrorBox and retained disabled/recovered answers were verified.

ONE synthetic Daily round1/QAR-2026-00001 was signed: first201lost, original frozen body/key replay returned the same16answers/findings1/stamp. Escape/Close remained locked while unknown. The primary harness then FAILED a test selector before any finding action: root-prefixed has-heading was wrongly evaluated inside a form. It was never rerun;181-ui-partial-journey.json /181-ui-partial.json preserve that outcome. Signing/creation was not repeated.

The first continuation opened confirmed1 and correctly received422 for a past-due action (d7822dc6a1f64bfaad358f7b23323dfb), then exposed a FRONTENDfield-feedback defect: flat details.due_date was not handled by the common fields mapper. The scoped QaRounds fix maps actual VALIDATION_ERROR+details.due_date to the date’s inline message/aria-invalid; it does not guess from English or broaden the shared mapper. This was not reported as a backend bug.
